Release Bot: Announcement: release train freeze starts Thursday 09:00 UTC. Minimal exceptions. See guidance below. :lock:
Kai Turner: Please confirm whether hotfixes to the embeddings pipeline are allowed during freeze?
Release Bot: Hotfixes allowed only for security, data-loss, or perf regressions that meet the emergency criteria. Must include a rollback plan and @OpsBot approval.
Nina Shah: Canary status: runtime v3.15 canary at 6% across eu-west and us-east. Errors steady, slight p99 increase in eu-west after the last patch.
Riley Chen: The p99 blip was traced to a retry storm from async batcher. Patch queued in PR #4217, ETA for backout/patch is 2 hours.
Victor Lee: Heads-up: Dedicated infra team will pause non-essential scaling ops during the freeze window to avoid noisy neighbor side effects.
Kai Turner: Reminder: DB migrations are not allowed unless they are backwards compatible or have been signed off by @Nina Shah and @Victor Lee.
OpsBot: To request a freeze exemption, create an RFC in /rfc/release-exceptions and tag @OpsBot with the approver GitHub handle and short justification. Template: "Title, Risk, Rollback, Owner, Approvers".
Nina Shah: Also re: nightly evals 1: they will run but results are "informational only" and will not trigger automated deploys during freeze.
Release Bot: Quick checklist: 1) stop non-critical merges by Thu 00:00 UTC, 2) pause scheduled batch jobs that touch embeddings during Thu 06-14 UTC, 3) notify customers if you have SLA-impacting changes. Post exceptions in this thread. :white_check_mark:
